name: apper
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow package-manager behavior: Apper defaults PackageKit transactions to OnlyTrusted, but its transaction flow can present an untrusted-package prompt and resend with trust disabled after user consent.
limitations: This application delegates payload verification to PackageKit/Flatpak/snapd/apt backends; the external backend version and active keyring are outside this checkout.
This evidence does not establish a complete primary self-updater classification.
